story_manifest.headline: World Cup players have grown taller
story_manifest.summary: Average listed height rises from 173.90 cm in 1930 to 182.76 cm in 2026.

story_manifest.headline: World Cup squads are older now
story_manifest.summary: Average age rises from 24.83 years in 1930 to 27.94 in 2026.

story_manifest.headline: Bosnia and Herzegovina is the tallest 2026 squad in the file
Panama is the oldest 2026 squad in the file
Group B is the tallest group on average
story_manifest.summary: Group B averages 185.69 cm, while Group K is oldest at 28.93 years.

story_manifest.headline: UEFA enters 2026 with the tallest confederation profile
story_manifest.summary: UEFA teams average 185.57 cm, ahead of CONMEBOL at 180.24 cm and the rest of the field.

story_manifest.headline: The oldest groups are not always the tallest ones
story_manifest.summary: Group K leads on age at 28.93 years, while Group B leads on height.

story_manifest.headline: Some 2026 teams changed physically far more than others
story_manifest.summary: The country comparison module shows which squads are much taller or older than their nearest 1994 or 1986 benchmark, and which ones barely moved.

story_manifest.headline: Erling Haaland is the most valuable player in this 2026 field
story_manifest.summary: Transfermarkt lists Erling Haaland at €200.00m for Norway.

story_manifest.headline: The value spread inside this field is enormous
story_manifest.summary: Listed values run from €25k for Craig Gordon of Scotland up to the elite end.

story_manifest.headline: France brings the most valuable squad in the field
story_manifest.summary: Using Transfermarkt squad pages, France leads at €1561.00m in listed player value.

story_manifest.headline: Harry Kane arrives as the top scorer in this squad pool
story_manifest.summary: Using Transfermarkt's player-performance endpoint, Harry Kane has 61 club goals in his current season.

story_manifest.headline: Michael Olise leads this field on current-season assists
story_manifest.summary: Michael Olise has 26 club assists in the current season.

story_manifest.headline: Gilberto Mora is the youngest serious scorer in the 2026 field
story_manifest.summary: At 17.00, Gilberto Mora already brings 4 current-season club goals.

story_manifest.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo is the oldest productive creator in the field
story_manifest.summary: At 41.00, Cristiano Ronaldo still has 3 current-season club assists.

story_manifest.headline: Manchester City sends the most players to this World Cup
story_manifest.summary: Manchester City contributes 19 players across 12 national teams.

story_manifest.headline: Carlo Ancelotti arrives with the deepest trophy cabinet
story_manifest.summary: Transfermarkt achievement pages credit Carlo Ancelotti with 40 titled honours across 22 competition types.
